resolvedTitle: Template:Data Yunara/Vow of the First Lands

fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} deal {{as|10%|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
fields.notes:
* The '''bonus''' damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}}.
** If '''Yunara''' critically strikes against a champion that has {{ii|Randuin's Omen}}, the '''bonus''' magic damage from ''Vow of the First Lands'' and the '''bonus''' magic damage on-hit from {{ai|Q|Yunara}} will both be reduced by 30%.{{bug|2}}
*** This can result in a critical strike yielding less bonus magic damage than if the basic attack had not critically struck.
